current.text: He is a rookie. Philadelphia drafted him 22nd overall in the 2026 draft.
He comes off the bench behind the starting guards Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe.
The 76ers also added Anfernee Simons and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, and their guard rotation is crowded.
Experts see almost no path to real minutes for him this season. The crowded guard rotation and Nick Nurse's heavy minutes for starters limit his rookie value.
In Summer League he played with restraint on 28% usage. He averaged 6 assists and 1.5 steals but shot 26% from three and 63% from the line.
He could grow into a 27-minute player in two years, or a trade could put him in a starting role.
He is not a draft target in our 12-team league.

durable.text: Experts rated him a top 10 prospect in the 2026 draft class.
Experts expect him to become a good shooter and a better player than Jared McCain.
